ctx.x: Well, now, after Basie and I separated, in the early years, I got them in contact with Basie too much. So I don't know what happened.

Well, you know, I always thought that sports and music went together. And boxers would sometimes turn out to be musicians. What about Archie Moore that he threw around with the trots of them? I keep hearing these different things because it may be just publicity, but… And some of the dances.
I never knew too much. Well, you say dances, that goes to Chiharay.
